MeetingCancellationV10/Cancellation1Guid: It is recommended that a meeting is canceled with the use of MeetingReference/MeetingIdentification, MeetingReference/Type and Security and Reason only. It is recommended that optional elements are not used.
MeetingInstructionCancellationRequestV10: It is recommended that the request to cancel a meeting instruction be done with the use of MeetingInstructionIdentification only and that the optional elements are avoided, unless otherwise specified by market practice rules and or legislation. If any optional elements are included, they must be identical to the information in the meeting instruction message being canceled.
Organisation44/OrganisationIdentificatio: In case of conflict between the Organization Identification and the Full Legal Name, it is recommended that the account servicer ask for clarification by means of an AdditionalInformationRequest message.
PaymentInstruction48/ChequeInstructionRu: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Check), then CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction is optional. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Check), then CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction is not allowed. Rule rationale: ChequeInstructionDetails may be present if the payment method is Check. It must not be present if the payment method is 'Transfer'.
PaymentInstruction48/CreditorAgentRule: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Check) and if CreditTransferTransaction/ ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is present and is equal to CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent) or RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAgent is mandatory. If PaymentMethod is CHK (Check) and if CreditTransferTransaction/ ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is not present or is not equal to CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent) or RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAgent is not allowed.
PaymentInstruction48/CreditorAndOrCredit: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Check), then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is not allowed. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Check) and if CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor is not present, then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is mandatory. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Check) and if CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor is present, then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is optional.
